post.description: Inserts a PENDING crawl_jobs row. The crawl-worker service polls for pending jobs, runs the Playwright crawl, and builds the knowledge graph asynchronously. If this exact targetUrl already has a COMPLETED crawl within CRAWL_TTL_HOURS (default 24h), that existing job/project is returned instead (response.cached=true) rather than queuing a new crawl.

projectId.description: Optional. Reuse an existing project ID to re-crawl into the same project; omit to start a new project.

storageState.description: Optional. A Playwright storageState (cookies + localStorage) captured from an already-authenticated browser session, e.g. via BrowserContext.storageState() after logging in yourself. When set, the crawl starts already logged in instead of crawling anonymously or pausing at AWAITING_CREDENTIALS.

credentials.description: Optional. Submit login credentials upfront instead of waiting for the crawl to hit a login wall and pause at AWAITING_CREDENTIALS.

autoRegister.description: Optional, default false. If the site requires login and `credentials` don't already work, fall back to heuristically filling and submitting a signup/registration form with those same credentials to create a new account, then proceed logged in as that account. First-successful credentials (submitted, reused, or freshly registered) are saved for this project and reused automatically on later crawls.

connectCdpUrl.description: Optional. Attach to an already-running, already-authenticated browser over CDP (Playwright's chromium.connectOverCDP) instead of launching a headless one -- for sites a login-form-fill heuristic or fresh account can't get through (2FA, CAPTCHA, OAuth-only sign-in like Gmail). The crawl reuses the browser's existing logged-in tab/context and never calls browser.close() on it, only the extra tab it opens itself, if any. The host must be listed in the operator-configured CDP_ALLOWED_HOSTS env var, or the request is rejected -- this deliberately isn't left open to arbitrary hosts, since it's an SSRF-relevant surface.

200.description: An existing COMPLETED crawl for this targetUrl is still within CRAWL_TTL_HOURS; it was returned instead of queuing a new crawl (response.cached=true)

400.description: targetUrl is required, or connectCdpUrl's host is not in CDP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Crawl job ID returned by POST /api/crawl

post.summary: Submit login credentials for a paused crawl
post.description: When a crawl hits a login wall on its start page, the job pauses with status AWAITING_CREDENTIALS and login_url set. Submit credentials here to resume it -- the worker logs in with Playwright and continues the crawl authenticated. Credentials are held only transiently: the worker deletes them from the database as soon as it reads them, whether or not the login attempt succeeds. Working credentials (submitted, or freshly auto-registered) are saved for this project and reused automatically on later crawls.

autoRegister.description: Optional. If logging in with these credentials fails, fall back to creating a new account with them instead of pausing again.

200.description: Credentials accepted; job set back to PENDING for the worker to retry

409.description: Job is not currently awaiting credentials

post.summary: Submit an authenticated session for a paused crawl
post.description: Alternative to /api/crawl/{id}/credentials for a job paused at AWAITING_CREDENTIALS: submit a Playwright storageState (cookies + localStorage) captured from an already-authenticated browser session instead of a username/password. The worker resumes the crawl using that session directly, without running the heuristic login form-fill. Stored only transiently -- the worker deletes it from the database as soon as it reads it.

200.description: Session accepted; job set back to PENDING for the worker to retry

409.description: Job is not currently awaiting credentials

get.description: Returns all Neo4j nodes (Page, Entity, Action, Workflow, WorkflowStep) and edges (HAS_PAGE/CHILD_OF with the clicked label+selector, RELATED_TO, HAS_ACTION, HAS_STEP, NEXT_STEP, etc.) for the project.

post.summary: Preview LLM-tailored narration for a workflow, alongside today's deterministic narration
post.description: Read-only comparison endpoint: gathers the workflow's crawled knowledge, generates deterministic narration (same logic used for real recordings), and asks a local Ollama model to rewrite it for the given job role/target audience/functionality focus, grounded in the same literal actions. Does not record video and does not persist to workflow_scripts. If the LLM call fails, llmAvailable is false and llmNarration is null per step -- deterministicNarration is always present.

get.summary: Get the project's high-level knowledge summary
get.description: Returns a lightweight domain summary (main entities, main workflows, discovered page count) intended to save downstream AI token usage compared to reading the full graph.

404.description: Summary not found for this project

StorageState.description: Playwright's BrowserContext.storageState() output -- cookies plus per-origin localStorage from an already-authenticated session. Passed through as-is to Playwright's newContext({ storageState }); not otherwise interpreted.

login_url.description: Set when status is AWAITING_CREDENTIALS: the page that needs login. POST credentials to /api/crawl/{id}/credentials, or an existing storageState to /api/crawl/{id}/session, to resume.

auto_register.description: If true, a login wall that the submitted credentials can't pass falls back to auto-registering a new account with them.

connect_cdp_url.description: If set, this crawl attaches to an already-running browser over CDP instead of launching a headless one.

cached.description: True if an existing completed crawl within CRAWL_TTL_HOURS was returned instead of queuing a new one

llmAvailable.description: False if the Ollama call failed or returned nothing usable -- llmNarration will be null on every step
